correctness.rationale: The full geometric exceptional-class list and intersection form yield 240 classes, and the 22 S8 partitions exhaust Frobenius actions on a stable octad. Two independently programmed exact verifiers reconstruct the table: one counts stable flags using Frobenius orbit decomposition, while the other independently enumerates exceptional integer classes and all 60480 disjoint triples and checks setwise invariance. Both pass all 22 table assertions, the 21/22 profile comparison and the equality of all four pair intersection classes for (5,3)/(7,1). This is an exhaustive finite character computation for a general conditional theorem, not evidence drawn from finitely sampled surfaces.

value.rationale: An eight-point Frobenius splitting partition is natural arithmetic descent data of the degree-one del Pezzo blow-up marking. The table gives a uniform reconstruction from ground-field finite-etale exceptional-curve incidence flags. More strongly it identifies an intrinsic minimum incidence arity: all intersection-labeled pair counts fail to separate two distinct Galois types, but mutually-disjoint stable triples do. This is a motivated full classification with a sharp geometric obstruction, rather than a minor numerical gain.
